'''Rikal Stargunner''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] member and aspiring [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kaeline Ungasan]]. When his boss tried to subvert the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]' financial control over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]], Stargunner accompanied him. Ungasan had set up a new [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]], the [[Ungasan Cross Country]], as a front for an illegal [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation, but the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Ree]], his accomplice, went missing. Stargunner and Ungasan later searched for Ree in [[Juaka Canyon]], engaging in a [[Lightfight|firefight]] with the native [[Talid/Legends|Talids]] and a group hired by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jer Blankuna]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Rikal Stargunner worked as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for [[Kaeline Ungasan]], an aspiring [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and member of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]],<ref name="Snow Job" /> in the [[Time/Legends|time]] period shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Era">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|sports/13328_1.html|Podracing Faces Uncertain Future}} implies that the events of ''[[Snow Job]]'' take place circa [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], which corresponds to the [[Rise of the Empire era]] as per {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}}.</ref> Ungassan wanted to subvert the financial control that the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] had over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] with their [[Ando Overland]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] event, as well as secretly [[Mining/Legends|mine]] the valuable metal [[Vonium/Legends|Vonium]] without having to get the land rights or permits. To do so, Ungasan planned to host a new racing event, the [[Ungasan Cross Country]]. He had the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Ree]] acquire scanning equipment from [[Geon Justic]] of the [[Elesa Mining Union]] in exchange for CSA merchandise, which he then had attached to [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]] in order to scan for deposits of Vonium during the new event. When Ungasan traveled to the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Elesa]] to check on this illicit mining operation, Stargunner accompanied him to the [[Miner's Union Hall|office]] of the Elesa Mining Union to speak to Justic about Ree's current location.<ref name="Snow Job" />

{{RPG|"[[Snow Job]]"}}
Ree had gone missing, so Justic told Ungasan where Ree had went, [[Juaka Canyon]], and they headed off. A group hired by [[Jer Blankuna]], the Hutts' Twi'lek agent on Ando Prime, was also looking for Ree, as Blankuna had told the group that Ree was his missing son in an attempt to hide his true motive of uncovering Ungasan's reasons for the Podrace. Once in the canyon together, Ungasan, Stargunner, and Ree had to fight off the native [[Talid/Legends|Talids]] as well as the group Blankuna had hired.<ref name="Snow Job" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
Stargunner was equipped with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], padded [[battle armor]], a [[field kit]], and a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]].<ref name="Revised Core Rulebook">''[[Snow Job]]'' says to refer to Stargunner as a General Elite Trooper (Soldier 4) found in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]'', which lists this equipment.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Rikal Stargunner was created as a character players meet while playing the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. He appeared in the "[[Snow Job]]" adventure in [[Star Wars Gamer 2|''Star Wars Gamer'' 2]], which was written by [[Daniel Kaufman]]<ref name="Snow Job" /> and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[February]] [[2001]].<ref name="Gamer 2">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010118.html|text=''Star Wars Gamer'' #2}}</ref> The story does not reveal the fate of Stargunner and his boss, instead leaving the outcome in the hands of the players: If Stargunner and Ungasan cannot win the fight, they would decide to surrender themselves to Blankuna's group&mdash;the players.<ref name="Snow Job" />
